triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: “I ask you for the second time—need I take off my shirt or not?” he said, still more sharply and irritably.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: “Well, what now? Are you going to flog me? That’s all that’s left for you,” he said, clenching his teeth and addressing the prosecutor.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: given us by Grigory, the old man you wounded.

triples.subject: Nikolay Parfenovitch
triples.quote: “What is the stone in your ring?” Mitya interrupted suddenly, as though awakening from a reverie. He pointed to one of the three large rings adorning Nikolay Parfenovitch’s right hand.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: given us by Grigory, the old man you wounded.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: “Nonsense!” he yelled, in a sudden frenzy, “it’s a barefaced lie. He couldn’t have seen the door open because it was shut. He’s lying!”

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: “It’s he who’s murdered him! He’s robbed him! No one else knew where the old man hid the envelope. It’s Smerdyakov, that’s clear, now!”

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: On the one hand we have the evidence of the open door from which you ran out, a fact which overwhelms you and us.

triples.subject: Nikolay Parfenovitch
triples.quote: Nikolay Parfenovitch laid upon the table a large and thick official envelope, on which three seals still remained intact.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: when only three hours earlier, on your own showing, you pledged your pistols for the sake of ten roubles!
